name: UCG-Industrial
title: Cloud Gateway Industrial
summary: Ruggedized fanless 10GbE Cloud Gateway with WiFi 7, PoE+++ ports and 270W PoE budget, -30..50°C.

extra.form_factor_options: wall, desktop stand incl., rack accessory sold separately
extra.no_ip_rating: rugged temp range but no IP rating listed

gotchas: Integrated WiFi is 2x2 WiFi 7 on 2.4/5 GHz only — no 6 GHz; add a U7 Pro/U7 Pro XG for 6 GHz clients.
'Industrial' = temperature-hardened and fanless, but no IP rating is listed — it's not an outdoor enclosure.
Only 5 copper LAN/WAN ports; PoE budget drops to 75W when fed from ATX 48V instead of the 350W DC brick.
NVR storage is just a 128GB microSD — fine for a handful of cameras (5x 4K max), not a real Protect NVR.
Only 50 managed UniFi devices; larger sites want UDM-Pro-Max.
best_for: harsh/hot closets, kiosks, small industrial sites needing gateway+PoE+WiFi in one box
powering 90W PoE devices from the gateway
